name: calibre-web-automated-book-downloader
description: This template was replaced by Shelfmark. Please migrate to shelfmark. An intuitive web interface for searching and requesting book downloads, designed to work seamlessly with Calibre-Web-Automated. This project streamlines the process of downloading books and preparing them for integration into your Calibre library. You must have already setup Calibre-Web-Automated for this to work. It is an add-on to it. The docker CloudFlareBypassForScrapping isn't needed anymore and can be remove ✨ Features 🌐 User-friendly web interface for book search and download 🔄 Automated download to your specified ingest folder 🔌 Seamless integration with Calibre-Web-Automated 📖 Support for multiple book formats (epub, mobi, azw3, fb2, djvu, cbz, cbr) 🛡️ Cloudflare bypass capability for reliable downloads 🐳 Docker-based deployment for quick setup Note that PDF are NOT supported at the moment (they do not get ingested by CWA, but if you want to just download them locally, you can add pdf to the SUPPORTED_FORMATS env If you are a donator on AA, you can use your Key in AA_DONATOR_API_KEY to speed up downloads and bypass the wait times. If disabling the cloudflare bypass, you will be using alternative download hosts, such as libgen or z-lib, but they usually have a delay before getting the more recent books and their collection is not as big as aa's. But this setting should work for the majority of books. CLOUDFLARE_PROXY_URL is ignored if USE_CF_BYPASS is set to false

paths.name: Calibre Web Automated Import Folder
paths.description: Mount should align with your Calibre-Web-Automated ingest folder.

variables.name: Container External Port
variables.description: Container external port. Follow FLASK PORT. Default: 8084

variables.name: FLASK_PORT
variables.description: FLASK port. If you change this, you need to recreate the

variables.name: FLASK_HOST
variables.description: Web interface binding. Default: 0.0.0.0

variables.name: Download dir (host)
variables.description: Download directory inside the docker. Default: /cwa-book-ingest. If you change this, you must change the path for 'Calibre Web Automated Import Folder'

variables.name: USE_CF_BYPASS
variables.description: Disable CF bypass and use alternative links instead. Default: true

variables.name: MAX_RETRY
variables.description: Maximum download retry attempts. Default: 3

variables.name: DEFAULT_SLEEP
variables.description: Retry delay (seconds). Default: 5

variables.name: MAIN_LOOP_SLEEP_TIME
variables.description: Processing loop delay (seconds)

variables.name: SUPPORTED_FORMATS
variables.description: Supported book formats. PDF is currently not supported. Default: epub,mobi,azw3,fb2,djvu,cbz,cbr

variables.name: BOOK_LANGUAGE
variables.description: Preferred language for books. Default: en

variables.name: Calibre-Web's database
variables.description: Used to enable authentication to the web gui using the same user/pass as calibre. Remove to disable authentication. MUST NOT BE EMPTY

variables.name: AA_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of Annas-Archive (could be changed for a proxy). Default: https://annas-archive.org

variables.name: AA_DONATOR_KEY
variables.description: Optional Donator key for Anna's Archive fast download API

variables.name: Use Book Title
variables.description: Use book title as filename instead of ID

variables.name: DEBUG
variables.description: Debug mode toggle. Default: false

variables.name: AA Additional URL
variables.description: Proxy URLs for AA, comma separated. Default empty

variables.name: HTTP Proxy
variables.description: HTTP PRoxy URL

variables.name: HTTPS Proxy
variables.description: HTTPS proxy URL

variables.name: Custom DNS
variables.description: Custom DNS IP

variables.name: USE DOH
variables.description: Use DNS over HTTPS

variables.name: Custom Script
variables.description: Path to an executable script that runs after each download before the file is moved to ingest directory

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR | CRITICAL

variables.name: Logging
variables.description: Enable log file in /var/log/cwa-book-downloader
